title: The News Says, the Bot Says: How Immigrants and Locals Differ in Chatbot-Facilitated News Reading
reasoning: The paper focuses on human-computer interaction (HCI) and user experience research regarding news reading behaviors. While it mentions 'moral evaluation' as a theoretical framing category for news retelling, the authors explicitly state that participants rarely made such evaluations. It does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, ethics, or moral systems.
